turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, a little stressed, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you help me make a playlist for a party where the ages go from four to eighty?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Fun challenge. Do you want it mostly in the background or will people dance?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, my eight year old spent forty pounds on in-game coins on my tablet. He didn't realise it was real money.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Oh no, that's really common. Do you want to try asking the store for a refund, or treat it as a lesson and just lock purchases from now on?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hold that thought, I need to talk to Daniel real quick. Stay quiet until I return.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Daniel, quick, hold this reflector. No, the silver side.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Which way is the silver side? They both look shiny to me.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The one that's blinding you. Tilt it up, toward her chin.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Little more. Perfect, stay exactly there.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: My arms are going to fall off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Twenty seconds. Can you manage twenty seconds?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Um, okay, yeah, I'm back. Sorry. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem. Your son's coin spree. Refund, or just lock it down?
